description: Three rounds of the [[58,16,3]] hypergraph product code as a Z memory, read out in the program; every ion reset; then three rounds as an X memory, read out by the grader (100 ions: 58 data, 42 ancillas, reset and reused every round). The circuit is the coloration schedule of Tremblay, Delfosse and Beverland (arXiv:2109.14609, Algorithm 1: X checks, then Z checks, seven layers each; circuit distance 3); the code is the product of the [7,4,3] Hamming code with itself. Goal 3 fixes this code and compares architectures by the time per round and the logical error rate per round (a round fails when either memory does) under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
